falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-11-04: with classify_provision(new_text) restored, test_dcp_table_row_is_graded_not_skipped FAILED (1 failed, 57 deselected); with the fix, 1 passed

functions.name: gate_chapter
functions.input: a cursor, an R2 client, council, chapter_key and the chapter's R2 path
functions.output: (grounded, flagged, skipped) counts; writes a fidelity verdict on each graded pending row
functions.if_none: a row whose document_id is NULL is judged by the unknown-document bar, as before this change

functions.name: plain_approvable
functions.input: the council_quote judge status and the rule body
functions.output: True only for an exact, at least 25-character rule starting a sentence and not an orphan lead-in
functions.if_none: an empty body is under 25 characters, so it is not approved

functions.name: _span
functions.input: a live PDF page's text and the answer key's first and last words
functions.output: the rule's full text on that page, or None
functions.if_none: None leaves the rule out and counts it as words_not_on_live_page -- never guessed
